snippet.title: Astronaut: The Best - Alpha Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Thank you for your interest in Astronaut: The Best!  We are impressed that you went so far as to find an unlisted video.  If you'd like, you can join our prestigious alpha. Simply join the Discord and complete a brief test of valor and piety:
https://discord.gg/zbDusCRmHw

Astronaut: The Best is an occult management sim where people aren't just numbers: they're incompetent screwups. Your duty is to turn them into national heroes, or the government will have you killed. 

Now available to Wishlist on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1239950/Astronaut_The_Best/
